moves.about: prooftext that a pot WITH meat in it signifies calamity, which is why R' Ḥanan's sign was taught of an empty pot

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי יהושע בן לוי: הרואה נהר בחלום, ישכים ויאמר
moves.summary: Since these images cut both ways, one should rise and recite the favourable verse before the unfavourable one takes effect.
moves.about: the favourable verse for one who dreams of a river

moves.cueHe: הרואה ענבים בחלום, ישכים ויאמר
moves.summary: Grapes and mountain, each with a favourable verse to forestall an unfavourable one.
moves.about: the favourable verse for one who dreams of grapes

moves.cueHe: הרואה שופר בחלום, ישכים ויאמר
moves.summary: The shofar of ingathering against the shofar of war.
moves.about: the favourable verse for one who dreams of a shofar

moves.cueHe: הרואה כלב בחלום, ישכים ויאמר
moves.summary: Dog and lion, each verse paired with its opposite.
moves.about: the favourable verse for one who dreams of a dog

moves.cueHe: הרואה תגלחת בחלום, ישכים ויאמר
moves.summary: Shave, well and reed — Joseph against Samson, living water against a wicked cistern, the Messiah's reed against Egypt's.
moves.about: the favourable verse for one who dreams of a shave

moves.cueHe: תנו רבנן: הרואה קנה בחלום — יצפה לחכמה
moves.summary: A baraita picks up the reed: kaneh is 'acquire wisdom', kanim 'acquire understanding'.
moves.about: prooftext that a reed portends wisdom and reeds understanding

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי זירא: קרא, קורא, קירא, קניא — כולהו מעלו לחלמא
moves.summary: R' Zeira adds the whole sound-family of kara, kura, kira and kanya as auspicious.
moves.about: brings the baraita on reeds, wisdom and understanding

moves.cueHe: תניא: אין מראין דלועין אלא למי שהוא ירא שמים בכל כחו
moves.summary: A further baraita: pumpkins are shown only to one wholly God-fearing.
moves.about: a second baraita: pumpkins are shown only to one who fears Heaven with all his might

moves.cueHe: הרואה שור בחלום, ישכים ויאמר
moves.summary: The ox joins the recite-first list: the firstling bullock against the goring ox.
moves.about: the favourable verse for one who dreams of an ox

moves.cueHe: תנו רבנן: חמשה דברים נאמרו בשור
moves.summary: A baraita of five ox-dreams, ending: one who rides it rises to greatness.
moves.about: brings the baraita of five things said about an ox seen in a dream

moves.cueHe: והתניא רכבו — מת!
moves.summary: Another baraita makes riding the ox a sign of death.
moves.about: whether riding an ox in a dream portends rising to greatness or imminent death

moves.cueHe: לא קשיא, הא דרכיב הוא לתורא, הא דרכיב תורא לדידיה
moves.summary: The two are distinguished by who rides whom.
moves.about: whether riding an ox in a dream portends greatness or death — resolved by who rides whom

moves.cueHe: הרואה חמור בחלום — יצפה לישועה
moves.summary: Donkey, cat, grapes and horse, the cat turning on the local word for it.
moves.about: prooftext that a donkey in a dream means one should await salvation

moves.cueHe: הרואה ישמעאל בחלום — תפלתו נשמעת
moves.summary: Ishmael son of Abraham — but not any Arab — means prayer heard; a camel means a death decree remitted.
moves.about: prooftext that a camel means a death decree was remitted

moves.cueHe: מאי קראה
moves.summary: R' Ḥama asks the verse behind the camel, and gives 'I will also surely bring you up again'.
moves.about: the scriptural source for the sign that a camel in a dream means a death decree was remitted

moves.cueHe: רב נחמן בר יצחק אמר: מהכא
moves.summary: Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak prefers 'the Lord also has put away your sin; you shall not die'.
moves.about: a rival prooftext for the camel omen

moves.cueHe: הרואה פינחס בחלום — פלא נעשה לו
moves.summary: Pinehas means a miracle, an elephant miracles, elephants miracles upon miracles.

moves.cueHe: והתניא כל מיני חיות יפין לחלום, חוץ מן הפיל ומן הקוף!
moves.summary: A baraita excludes the elephant from the auspicious animals.
moves.about: whether an elephant seen in a dream is an auspicious sign

moves.cueHe: הא דמסרג, הא דלא מסרג
moves.summary: Saddled it is auspicious, unsaddled it is not.
moves.about: whether an elephant is auspicious — resolved by whether it is saddled

moves.cueHe: הרואה הונא בחלום — נס נעשה לו
moves.summary: Names containing nun portend miracles; a eulogy means heaven has spared him.
moves.about: whether a eulogy seen in a dream is a good omen only while it is still in writing

moves.cueHe: והני מילי בכתבא
moves.summary: The eulogy sign holds only while the eulogy is still in writing.

moves.cueHe: העונה ״יהא שמיה רבא מברך״
moves.summary: Answering the kaddish response in a dream assures the World-to-Come; reciting Shema shows one worthy of the Divine Presence.

moves.cueHe: המניח תפילין בחלום — יצפה לגדולה
moves.summary: Donning phylacteries portends greatness, from 'all the peoples of the earth shall see'.
moves.about: prooftext that donning phylacteries in a dream portends greatness

moves.cueHe: רבי אליעזר הגדול אומר: אלו תפילין שבראש
moves.summary: A baraita identifies the Name called upon you with the head-phylacteries.
moves.about: 'the name of the Lord is called upon you' refers to the phylacteries of the head

moves.cueHe: והני מילי דלא סיים
moves.summary: Praying in a dream is auspicious only while the prayer is unfinished.
moves.about: brings R' Eliezer the Great's exposition of that verse

moves.cueHe: הבא על אמו בחלום — יצפה לבינה
moves.summary: Forbidden unions in a dream are turned into understanding, Torah, wisdom and the World-to-Come by wordplay on the verses.
moves.about: prooftext that relations with one's mother in a dream portend understanding

moves.cueHe: והני מילי דלא ידע לה ולא הרהר בה מאורתא
moves.summary: Only if he did not know her and had not been thinking of her.
moves.about: prooftext that relations with a betrothed girl portend Torah

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי חייא בר אבא: הרואה חטים בחלום — ראה שלום
moves.summary: Wheat is peace; barley (se'orim) is sar avon, iniquity removed.
moves.about: prooftext that wheat in a dream is a sight of peace

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי זירא: אנא לא סלקי מבבל לארץ ישראל עד דחזאי שערי בחלמא
moves.summary: R' Zeira waited for that very dream before going up to Eretz Yisrael.
moves.about: whether barley in a dream signifies that one's iniquities are taken away

moves.cueHe: הרואה גפן טעונה בחלום
moves.summary: A laden vine means no miscarriage; a planted branch means one should await the Messiah.
moves.about: prooftext that a laden vine means his wife will not miscarry

moves.cueHe: הרואה תאנה בחלום
moves.summary: Fig and pomegranate: Torah preserved, business multiplied, and slices meaning Torah or mitzvot by the dreamer's standing.
moves.about: prooftext that a fig tree means his Torah is preserved in him

moves.cueHe: הרואה זיתים בחלום
moves.summary: Olives, olive trees, olive oil and dates, each with its verse; the fruit-versus-tree distinction is drawn.
moves.about: prooftext that olive trees portend many children

moves.cueHe: איכא דאמרי הרואה זית בחלום — שם טוב יוצא לו
moves.summary: A second version makes the olive tree a good name rather than many children.
moves.about: prooftext for the variant reading that an olive tree portends a good name

moves.cueHe: אמר רב יוסף, הרואה עז בחלום
moves.summary: Goat, myrtle, etrog and lulav, each read from a verse or a wordplay.
moves.about: prooftext that goats portend blessed years

moves.cueHe: אמר עולא, ואמרי לה במתניתא תנא: והוא דחזא בכנייהו
moves.summary: The myrtle sign holds only if seen on the stem.
moves.about: whether myrtle in a dream portends success only when it is seen on its stem

moves.cueHe: הרואה אווז בחלום — יצפה לחכמה
moves.summary: A goose portends wisdom, and relations with it headship of the yeshiva.
moves.about: prooftext that a goose portends wisdom

moves.cueHe: אמר רב אשי: אני ראיתיה, ובאתי עליה, וסלקית לגדולה
moves.summary: Rav Ashi confirms it from his own dream and career.
moves.about: whether dreaming of relations with a goose portends becoming head of the yeshiva

moves.cueHe: הרואה תרנגול בחלום — יצפה לבן זכר
moves.summary: Rooster, hen and eggs; breaking eggs, nuts, cucumbers or glass means the request is granted.

moves.cueHe: הנכנס לכרך — נעשו לו חפציו
moves.summary: Entering a city means desires fulfilled; shaving head and beard is auspicious for the whole family.
moves.about: prooftext that entering a city means his desires are fulfilled

moves.cueHe: היושב בעריבה קטנה — שם טוב יוצא לו
moves.summary: A small boat gives him a good name, a large one his family too — but only if it rides high.
moves.about: whether the boat sign holds only when the boat is riding high on the waves

moves.cueHe: הנפנה בחלום — סימן יפה לו
moves.summary: Defecating is auspicious, from 'he that is bent down shall speedily be loosed' — provided he does not wipe.
moves.about: prooftext that defecating in a dream is a good omen

moves.cueHe: העולה לגג בחלום — עולה לגדולה
moves.summary: Climbing to the roof is greatness, climbing down its loss; then torn clothes, nakedness, arrest and the neck chain.
moves.about: whether being bound in a dream signifies added heavenly protection even when it is a mere rope rather than a neck chain

moves.cueHe: אביי ורבא דאמרי תרווייהו: כיון שעלה — עלה
moves.summary: Abaye and Rava jointly deny the descent: once he has gone up, he has gone up.
moves.about: whether a dream of descending after climbing cancels the omen of greatness

moves.cueHe: הנכנס לאגם בחלום — נעשה ראש ישיבה
moves.summary: A marsh makes him head of the yeshiva, a forest only head of the advanced students.

moves.cueHe: רב פפא ורב הונא בריה דרב יהושע חזו חלמא
moves.summary: Rav Pappa and Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua dreamt exactly that, and were appointed accordingly.
moves.about: the dream who dreamed he entered a marsh and became head of the yeshiva, cited to confirm the preceding sign

moves.cueHe: איכא דאמרי תרווייהו לאגמא עיילי
moves.summary: In a second version both entered a marsh and the hanging drum made the difference.
moves.about: the dream who dreamed he entered a forest and was made head only of the advanced students, cited to confirm the preceding sign

moves.cueHe: אמר רב אשי: אנא עיילית לאגמא ותלאי טבלא
moves.summary: Rav Ashi, who became head of the yeshiva, dreamt marsh and drum together.
moves.about: whether it is the hanging drum rather than the marsh that marks the head of the yeshiva

moves.cueHe: תני תנא קמיה דרב נחמן בר יצחק: המקיז דם בחלום
moves.summary: A reciter teaches before Rav Naḥman bar Yitzḥak that bloodletting means transgressions forgiven.
moves.about: the tannaitic teaching that bloodletting in a dream means his transgressions are forgiven

moves.cueHe: והתניא: עונותיו סדורין לו!
moves.summary: Another baraita says they are enumerated against him.
moves.about: whether bloodletting in a dream means his transgressions are forgiven or that they are enumerated against him

moves.cueHe: מאי סדורין — סדורין לימחל
moves.summary: Enumerated, that is, in order to be forgiven.
moves.about: the two bloodletting baraitot are reconciled by reading 'enumerated' as 'enumerated to be forgiven'

moves.cueHe: תני תנא קמיה דרב ששת: הרואה נחש בחלום
moves.summary: Before Rav Sheshet: a snake means livelihood ready, its bite doubled livelihood, killing it livelihood lost.
moves.about: the tannaitic teaching on the snake and one's livelihood

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה רב ששת: כל שכן שנכפלה פרנסתו
moves.summary: Rav Sheshet reverses the last clause: killing it doubles his livelihood all the more.
moves.about: whether killing a snake in a dream means one's livelihood is lost or all the more so doubled

moves.cueHe: ולא היא, רב ששת הוא דחזא חויא בחלמיה וקטליה
moves.summary: The setama denies it: Rav Sheshet had himself dreamt of killing a snake and was reading his own dream well.
moves.about: whether Rav Sheshet's reversal holds — the setama denies it and puts it down to his own dream

moves.cueHe: תני תנא קמיה דרבי יוחנן: כל מיני משקין יפין לחלום חוץ מן היין
moves.summary: Before R' Yoḥanan: all drinks are auspicious except wine, which cuts both ways, with a verse for each.
moves.about: the tannaitic teaching that all drinks are auspicious except wine

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה רבי יוחנן לתנא: תני: תלמיד חכם לעולם טוב לו
moves.summary: R' Yoḥanan has him recite that for a Torah scholar wine is always auspicious.
moves.about: prooftext that for a Torah scholar wine is always a good omen

moves.cueHe: אמר רבי יוחנן: השכים ונפל פסוק לתוך פיו — הרי זה נבואה קטנה
moves.summary: A verse that falls into one's mouth on waking is a minor prophecy.
moves.about: brings the baraita of the three kings, and with it the series of prophets, writings, sages and scholars

moves.cueHe: תנו רבנן, שלשה מלכים הם
moves.summary: A baraita of triads opens: David piety, Solomon wisdom, Ahab calamity.

moves.cueHe: שלשה נביאים הם
moves.summary: Three prophetic books: Kings greatness, Ezekiel wisdom, Isaiah consolation, Jeremiah calamity.

moves.cueHe: שלשה כתובים גדולים הם
moves.summary: Three greater Writings: Psalms piety, Proverbs wisdom, Job calamity.

moves.cueHe: שלשה כתובים קטנים הם
moves.summary: Three lesser Writings, plus Esther for a miracle.

moves.cueHe: שלשה חכמים הם
moves.summary: Three Sages: Rabbi wisdom, R' Elazar ben Azarya wealth, R' Yishmael ben Elisha calamity.

moves.cueHe: שלשה תלמידי חכמים הם
moves.summary: Three untitled scholars: Ben Azzai piety, Ben Zoma wisdom, Aḥer calamity.

moves.cueHe: כל מיני חיות יפות לחלום, חוץ מן הפיל והקוף והקפוד
moves.summary: All animals are auspicious except elephant, monkey and long-tailed ape.
moves.about: adduces the Master's ruling that an elephant portends miracles, against the list that excludes it

moves.cueHe: והאמר מר, הרואה פיל בחלום פלא נעשה לו!
moves.summary: But the Master made the elephant a sign of miracles.
moves.about: whether an elephant seen in a dream is an auspicious sign

moves.cueHe: לא קשיא, הא דמסרג, הא דלא מסרג
moves.summary: Saddled and unsaddled again.
moves.about: whether an elephant is auspicious — resolved again by whether it is saddled

moves.cueHe: כל מיני מתכת יפין לחלום, חוץ ממר, פסל, וקרדום
moves.summary: Metals, fruits and vegetables in the same all-except form, with the handle qualification.
moves.about: whether hoe, chisel and axe are inauspicious only when seen mounted on their handles

moves.cueHe: והאמר רב: לא איעתרי עד דחזאי ראשי לפתות!
moves.summary: Rav became wealthy only after dreaming of turnip heads.
moves.about: whether turnip heads seen in a dream are an inauspicious sign

moves.cueHe: כי חזא — בכנייהו חזא
moves.summary: Rav saw them still on their stems; picked, they are a bad sign.
moves.about: adduces Rav's report of his own dream against the ruling that turnip heads are inauspicious

moves.cueHe: כל מיני צבעונין יפין לחלום, חוץ מן התכלת
moves.summary: The catalogue closes with colours and birds on the same pattern.
moves.about: whether Rav's auspicious turnip heads were seen picked or still on their stems
